instruction: Full-shot candid photograph of a family in a grassy park under a bright sky. On the left, the woman in the black leather jacket and blue jeans (R2) stands smiling as she holds the baby in denim overalls (R3) up in the air. The man in the white hoodie and beige pants (R1) stands on the right, looking towards them with a warm, happy smile. The family enjoys their time together on the green lawn, surrounded by distant trees. Bright, direct daylight casts soft shadows on the grass, capturing a joyful moment.
